new_destinations.name: Mount Buffalo National Park
new_destinations.name_evidence: Parks Victoria visitor page "Mount Buffalo National Park" and victoriashighcountry.com.au list it as a flagship High Country park; every national park is a destination (>=4 kept spots).

new_destinations.name: Alpine National Park
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page "Alpine National Park" and Parks Victoria "Alpine National Park" visitor page; flagship Victorian national park.

new_destinations.name: Mansfield
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page "Mansfield (Victoria)" (covers Mount Buller and Lake Eildon) and victoriashighcountry.com.au Mansfield/Mount Buller region.

new_destinations.name: Bright
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page "Bright (Victoria)", the hub of the Alpine Valleys; guidebook regional town.

new_destinations.name: Beechworth
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page "Beechworth" and victoriashighcountry.com.au (gold-rush heritage town; Yackandandah and Chiltern are its day trips).

new_destinations.name: Wangaratta
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page "Wangaratta", regional hub covering Glenrowan, Milawa and the King Valley wine country.

new_destinations.name: Wodonga
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page "Wodonga" (twin city with Albury); Victorian-side base for Hume Dam and the upper Murray.

stronger_left_out.name: Porepunkah
stronger_left_out.reason: Village with no specific sight named (rule 2).

stronger_left_out.name: Mount Beauty
stronger_left_out.reason: Wikivoyage Tawonga-Mount Beauty lists services and a lookout but the model town itself has no sight; only the gorge walk and Bogong lookout are draws.

stronger_left_out.name: Dinner Plain
stronger_left_out.reason: Alpine village base; sources list walks and tours but no distinct sight, and a town is a spot only when the town itself is a draw (COVERAGE: towns).

stronger_left_out.name: Eildon
stronger_left_out.reason: Town wrapper; the draw is Lake Eildon and houseboat hire, and no distinct sight is listed.

stronger_left_out.name: Old Tallangatta
stronger_left_out.reason: Visible only at very low water, not there whenever visitors arrive (rule 4).

stronger_left_out.name: Vallejo Gantner Hut
stronger_left_out.reason: A hut/memorial stopover for hikers on a remote track, not a half-hour stop (rule 2/3).

stronger_left_out.name: Glenrowan Siege Site
stronger_left_out.reason: Wikivoyage says you can walk the siege site but little remains standing. For: the historic site of Kelly's last stand. Against: minor, short, and the museum covers the story.

stronger_left_out.name: Mansfield Botanic Park
stronger_left_out.reason: Wikivoyage itself: "nothing too special"; local park (rule 3).

strongest_outsiders.name: Murray to the Mountains Rail Trail

benchmark: Region has no benchmark places (Red Rocks, Kapiti, Ninety Mile Beach etc. are other regions). Negative-benchmark checks: no vehicle/operator spots, no weekly markets, no civic buildings kept; Dinner Plain, Eildon and Porepunkah (town wrappers with no distinct sight) rejected.

counts.note: inside_destinations = 41 new spots + existing Hume Dam; 7 kept places become destinations themselves
